QF.id: Introduction to AML, CFT and Proliferation Financing_6

question.text: How many Recommendations has the FATF issued as the global standard against money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing?

answer.text: 49 Recommendations covering only anti-money laundering measures
25 Recommendations covering AML and CFT only
40 Recommendations covering AML, CFT, and countering proliferation financing
30 Recommendations covering banking sector compliance only

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that FATF has issued forty Recommendations to fight money laundering, and separately confirms FATF's global role in action against money laundering, terrorist financing and proliferation financing. The keyed answer combines these two source-supported facts. The Trap: 49 is offered as a distractor for candidates who half-remember the older 40 + 9 figure, and 25 or 30 are round-number distractors. The scope is also not limited to banking, which rules out option D. Note: Claims about the historical merger of the 9 Special Recommendations into the current 40, the 2012 revision, DNFBP coverage and India's latest FATF Mutual Evaluation are not relied upon here because they were not located on the source pages checked for this item.
